title: 문자, 선물, 전화: 누구에게? 누구에게서?
objective: By the end, you can use 에게 for "to a person or animal", 에게서 for "from a person", and 에게로 for "toward a person". You can also choose 에 instead for places and things.
summary: Learn the particle 에게 and its two related forms, 에게서 and 에게로, to say who you give, send, or say something to, and who it comes from.

task.title: USE 에게, 에게서, 에게로
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, reorder, fix, or write the Korean as the instruction says.

forms.when: After a person or animal, with verbs like 주다, 보내다, 전화하다, 말하다, 쓰다. The form is the same after any noun, with or without a final consonant.
forms.exampleMeaning: I sent a text to my younger sibling.

forms.when: After a person, when something comes from them: 받다, 배우다, 듣다, 전화가 오다, 편지가 오다. With 받다, 배우다, 듣다, 에게 is also possible (친구에게 선물을 받았어요).
forms.exampleMeaning: Yesterday I got a call from a friend.

forms.when: After a person or animal, with moving verbs like 가다 and 오다. It points to the direction of the movement.

watchOut: 학교에게 전화했어요 (X) → 학교에 전화했어요 (O): Use 에 for places, things, and groups (schools, companies, shops). 에게 is only for people and animals.
꽃에게 물을 줘요 (X) → 꽃에 물을 줘요 (O): Plants are not people or animals, so use 에.
(I got a call from Mom.) 엄마에게 전화가 왔어요 (X) → 엄마에게서 전화가 왔어요 (O): With 오다, 에게 marks who receives it, so 엄마에게 전화가 왔어요 means Mom got a call. To say it came from Mom, use 에게서.
친구 에게 (X) → 친구에게 (O): Write particles together with the noun, with no space.
exercises: Choose 에게 or 에: ①고양이(에게 / 에) 밥을 줘요. ②은행(에게 / 에) 전화했어요. ③나무(에게 / 에) 물을 줬어요.
Fill in the blank (An email came from my older brother.): 어제 형____ 이메일이 왔어요.
Read and answer in Korean. Who sent the message?: 지훈 씨는 어제 유나 씨에게서 메시지를 받았어요.
Put the words in order: 썼어요 / 할머니에게 / 저는 / 편지를
Find and fix the mistake: 저는 회사에게 이메일을 보냈어요.
Write in Korean with 에게로 (The baby went toward Dad. Use 아기, 아빠, 가다, past tense.):
answers: ① 에게 ② 에 ③ 에
저는 할머니에게 편지를 썼어요. (저는 편지를 할머니에게 썼어요.)
